reasons: Datadog sums across all matching series (sum: with no by-clause), but the candidate uses avg(), which gives the mean per series instead of the total; the correct aggregation is sum(rate(...)).
The quantity matches: nginx.requests is a monotonic sum of requests, so rate() over $__rate_interval yields requests per second, the same unit as nginx.net.request_per_s.
No grouping is present on either side, and the $scope template variable has no prefix and default *, so it is correctly dropped and the series set is the same.
Outcome translated is appropriate because no Datadog function is involved and an exact translation exists.
